content:
Last week, Apple sued OpenAI, accusing its former employee of stealing trade secrets 'for OpenAI's benefit.'

It is reported that during the lawsuit process, Apple has directly sent letters to several former employees currently working at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued legal preservation notices to approximately 40 former employees.

A preservation notice is a formal written notification sent to an individual or organization, requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be related to legal disputes. Such notices typically specify what must be preserved.

This move reflects Apple's suspicion that trade secret theft may extend beyond the scope named in the initial lawsuit filed last week.

A refresher: Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, and also names former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.
